description: This script detects text bounding boxes and recognized text in video frames using EasyOCR, with additional capability to process subtitle files (SRT/ASS) to detect overlapping text via OCR, and adjusts subtitle positioning accordingly. It includes functions for frame extraction, OCR detection, and subtitle file manipulation, especially for ASS subtitles, to move or update subtitle cues based on detected text overlap.

methods.name: List[np.ndarray] extract_frames(video_path: str, start_sec: float, end_sec: float, fps: int = 1)
methods.description: Extracts frames from a video between specified start and end times at a specified frame rate.

methods.name: List[dict] detect_text_boxes_with_easyocr(frames: List[np.ndarray], languages=['en'], gpu=False)
methods.description: Detects text boxes and recognized text in each provided video frame using EasyOCR.

methods.name: detect_text_boxes_in_timeframe(video_path: str, start_sec: float, end_sec: float, fps: int = 1, languages=['en'], gpu=False)
methods.description: Extracts video frames within a given time range and detects text boxes using OCR.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,int,int] default_subtitle_box(frame_width: int, frame_height: int, region: str = "bottom")
methods.description: Returns default subtitle region rectangle based on video dimensions.

methods.name: List[int] get_frame_indices(start_ms: int, end_ms: int, fps: float, vid_total_frames: int, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Calculates frame indices corresponding to subtitle cue timing for sampling.

methods.name: bool text_overlap_in_box(text_results: list, box: Tuple[int, int, int, int])
methods.description: Checks if any detected text overlaps with a specified bounding box.

methods.name: process_subtitle_overlap( video_path: str, subs_path: str, output_path: str, sample_rate: int = 2, ocr_languages: Optional[List[str]] = None, gpu: bool = False, default_region: str = "bottom" )
methods.description: Analyzes subtitle cues for overlapping on-screen text via OCR, moves cues if overlap is detected, and writes an updated ASS subtitle file with proper formatting and style patches.
